name: Progress MS-24
about: Progress MS-24 (2023-125A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2023 Aug 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 Aug 24), held fixed
